strategy: Read files with the read tool before referencing their content in reasoning.
Use the edit tool for in-place file changes; never use sed -i or awk -i inplace.
Use the search tool for repo-wide content search before falling back to rg via exec.
Prefix every non-validator exec invocation with a one-line EXEC: <reason> in reasoning.
Re-run validators after each substantive change.
summary: OpenClaw-specific tool discipline with bare-signal compatibility for Evolver scanner normalization. Includes both qualified (tool_bypass:exec-on-grep) and bare (tool_bypass) signal forms to survive Evolver's qualified->bare normalization.
